rules.statement: The prevention by fraud or force of the execution of a decree must be strictly traceable to an action done within the ten years immediately preceding the date of the application for execution.
rules.supporting_quote: "The prevention by fraud or force of the execution of a decree in order to deprive a judgement-debtor of the benefit of section 337 (a) of the Civil Procedure Code must be strictly traceable to an action done within the ten years immediately preceding the date of the application for execution."
